player_0.content: New plan: I failed because I wrote a long, conversational explanation and a narrative proposal instead of strictly adhering to the required format. The rules explicitly state that public messages must not include square brackets (which trigger a secret proposal) and must not contain any text other than the proposal itself. I mistakenly tried to explain my strategy and then describe the proposal in plain English. Next time, I will immediately output the exact string required for a public message: a simple list of items I want, separated by commas, with no brackets, no labels like "My proposal:", and no explanatory text. For example, if I want the canvases, I will output exactly: "2 canvases".
